name: Cheesecake Cup
steps: Crush biscuits finely and mix with melted butter. Divide between four glasses and press lightly into a base.
Beat cream cheese with sugar, lemon juice and vanilla until smooth and free of lumps.
In a separate chilled bowl, whip cold cream to soft peaks.
Fold whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture gently and spoon over the biscuit bases.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Wash, hull and slice strawberries.
Top with strawberries just before serving. This is a spoonable no-bake cup dessert and contains no gelatin or eggs.
passiveTime: Allow additional soaking, resting, chilling or fermentation as specified in the steps.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
